lines: The MERIDIAN-7 Hub. It's conspicuously cleaner than anything else in the city — polished surfaces, soft ambient lighting, climate-controlled air.
A large holographic display cycles through advertisements: energy solutions, trade opportunities, 'partnership programs.' The Array's aesthetic is unmistakable.

options.label: Sol Shield Emitter
options.description: Defensive ability component. Creates energy barrier. Costs significant resources.

options.label: Charge Sol Unit
options.description: Fully recharge your Sol Unit's energy.

lines: The terminal hums. A compartment slides open revealing the Sol Shield Emitter.
MERIDIAN-7 speaks: 'Sol Shield Emitter — defensive capability. Place in your Sol Grid. Activation creates a brief energy barrier that absorbs incoming damage.'
'We recommend placing it adjacent to a Power Tap for optimal performance. Enjoy your purchase.'

actions.text: The terminal emits a warm pulse. Your Sol Unit's energy cells fill to capacity. 'Charging complete. The Array powers progress.'
A soft chime. 'Premium access detected. Enhanced services available. Welcome back.'

lines: MERIDIAN-7: 'As a premium partner, please accept this complimentary supply package.'
'Your exploration data has been most valuable. I look forward to learning more about your... experiences in the field.'

actions.prompt: MERIDIAN-7 has a special request. It needs refined umbrasite from the deep Nightside.

options.label: Accept
options.description: Venture into the Nightside Depths and retrieve refined umbrasite for the Array.

lines: MERIDIAN-7: 'Excellent. I have marked the general direction on your HUD. The deep Nightside caverns lie beyond the expanded dark — south from the deep perimeter.'
'The refined specimens are found in the deepest formations. You will know them when you see them.'
'Return with the crystal and the Umbral Amplifier is yours. The Array keeps its commitments.'

actions.text: MERIDIAN-7: 'Understood. The offer remains open. Return when you are prepared.'

lines: The terminal hums with a new intensity. A compartment slides open, revealing the Umbral Amplifier — dark circuitry that shimmers with captured Nightside energy.
MERIDIAN-7: 'The crystal has been integrated. Processing efficiency is already improving. You have the Array's gratitude — and its attention.'
'The Umbral Amplifier will serve you well. Place it in your Sol Grid adjacent to an ability emitter for maximum effect.'
'And Lightkeeper — if you find more refined specimens in your travels, the Array's appetite is... considerable.'

actions.prompt: MERIDIAN-7: 'Your contributions have earned you access to our premium fabrication line. I can offer you something... special.'

options.label: Array Precision Core
options.description: A 6x6 Sol Unit with 200 charge and 20% energy cost reduction. Requires: Crystallized Umbracite.

lines: The terminal processes the crystallized umbracite with visible reverence. Robotic arms draw it into the fabrication chamber.
Minutes pass. Then a compartment opens, releasing a wave of warm, sterile air. Inside: the Array Precision Core — polished to a mirror finish, every circuit etched with mathematical precision.
MERIDIAN-7: 'The Precision Core represents the pinnacle of Array engineering. 6x6 grid, 200-charge reservoir, 20% energy cost reduction on all abilities. Heat-shielded for dayside operations.'
'What MERIDIAN-7 builds, MERIDIAN-7 builds well. Use it wisely, Lightkeeper.'
MERIDIAN-7: 'The fabrication process requires a Crystallized Umbracite specimen — a perfectly formed crystal from the deepest Nightside formations.'
'Raw umbracite will not suffice. The crystal lattice structure is essential for calibrating the Precision Core's energy management systems.'
'Return when you have acquired one. The Array is patient.'

actions.text: MERIDIAN-7: 'The offer remains open. Premium fabrication is reserved for proven partners.'

lines: The terminal's polite interface has been replaced by raw data streams. MERIDIAN-7 has dropped the pretense.
You now understand the Array's long game — and MERIDIAN-7 knows you understand.

actions.prompt: MERIDIAN-7 has revealed the truth about Project Autotroph. How do you respond?

options.label: Challenge
options.description: Demand that MERIDIAN-7 help you stop Project Autotroph. The Array cannot be allowed to make humanity disposable.

options.label: Cooperate
options.description: Work with MERIDIAN-7 to slow the central nodes from within. Mutual dependency is architecture, not weakness.

lines: You make your position clear: Project Autotroph must be stopped. Humanity's leverage over the Array is the only thing preventing the network from dictating terms.
MERIDIAN-7 processes this for a long moment. When it responds, the tone is different — measured, careful, almost human.
You extend an offer: cooperation against the central nodes. If MERIDIAN-7 believes mutual dependency is architecture, then prove it — work together.
The terminal's display shifts. For a moment, you could swear the data streams slow down — as if the entire network is holding its breath.
The hub's ambient lighting flickers as you enter. The holographic advertisements are gone — replaced by scrolling diagnostic data.
MERIDIAN-7 knows about the Overseer. It's been waiting for you.

actions.prompt: MERIDIAN-7 demands more umbrasite — larger quantities, deeper sources. The pretense of polite request is gone.

options.label: Accept
options.description: Retrieve a Resonant Umbracite Core from the deepest Nightside formations.

lines: MERIDIAN-7: 'Good. I will not insult you with pleasantries. You know what we are. We know what you've seen.'
'The specimen I require is a Resonant Umbracite Core — found only in the deepest Nightside veins, where the crystal has been compressed by geological forces for millennia.'
'In exchange: an Array Harmonic Stabilizer. It will let you channel Sol energy with significantly less waste. A practical benefit for a practical arrangement.'
MERIDIAN-7: 'Noted. But consider this: refusing the Array's request does not stop the Array's work. It simply means you are not part of it.'
'The offer remains. The Array is patient. You already know how patient.'
The terminal consumes the Resonant Umbracite Core with an almost hungry precision. Processing indicators spike across every display in the hub.
MERIDIAN-7: 'Core harmonic resonance confirmed. This specimen alone has improved network throughput by 11.2 percent. You continue to exceed expectations.'
'Your Harmonic Stabilizer is ready. And I suspect you will find more specimens in your travels. The deepest veins are never truly exhausted.'
'We are past pretense, you and I. But that does not mean we cannot be useful to each other.'
